title: Draw a Cat
description: Learn to draw a cute cat face step by step!

steps.instruction: Draw a large circle in the center. This will be the cat's head.
steps.tip: Use light strokes so you can erase if needed.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='150' r='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 1: Draw Circle%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Add two small triangles on top of the circle for ears.
steps.tip: Make them pointy but not too sharp.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='150' r='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='110,80 100,40 120,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='190,80 180,40 200,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 2: Add Ears%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw two circles for the eyes. Leave a small white circle inside each eye.
steps.tip: Eyes should be spaced apart evenly.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='150' r='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='110,80 100,40 120,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='190,80 180,40 200,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='120' cy='130' r='15' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='120' cy='130' r='8' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='180' cy='130' r='15' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='180' cy='130' r='8' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 3: Add Eyes%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Add a small triangular nose between the eyes.
steps.tip: Make it pink or red!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='150' r='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='110,80 100,40 120,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='190,80 180,40 200,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='120' cy='130' r='15' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='120' cy='130' r='8' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='180' cy='130' r='15' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='180' cy='130' r='8' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,155 145,165 155,165' fill='%23ff69b4'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 4: Add Nose%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw a curved mouth below the nose. Add whiskers with small lines.
steps.tip: Make it smile and look happy!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='150' r='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='110,80 100,40 120,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='190,80 180,40 200,70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='120' cy='130' r='15' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='120' cy='130' r='8' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='180' cy='130' r='15' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='180' cy='130' r='8' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,155 145,165 155,165' fill='%23ff69b4'/%3E%3Cpath d='M 140 170 Q 150 180 160 170' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='100' y1='155' x2='70' y2='150' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='100' y1='165' x2='70' y2='165' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='200' y1='155' x2='230' y2='150' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='200' y1='165' x2='230' y2='165' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 5: Add Mouth %26 Whiskers%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

title: Draw a House
description: Create a cozy little house with a colorful design!

steps.instruction: Draw a square for the house body.
steps.tip: Make sure all corners are clean and straight.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='120' width='100' height='100' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 1: Draw Square%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw a triangle on top of the square for the roof.
steps.tip: The triangle should cover the top of the square.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='120' width='100' height='100' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 100,120 200,120' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 2: Add Roof%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw a rectangle in the center for the door.
steps.tip: Make it tall but not too wide.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='120' width='100' height='100' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 100,120 200,120' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Crect x='135' y='160' width='30' height='60' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 3: Add Door%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw two small squares for windows on each side of the door.
steps.tip: Make them the same size.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='120' width='100' height='100' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 100,120 200,120' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Crect x='135' y='160' width='30' height='60' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Crect x='110' y='145' width='15' height='15' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Crect x='175' y='145' width='15' height='15' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 4: Add Windows%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Add details: a small circle for a doorknob and lines in the windows.
steps.tip: Color it in with your favorite colors!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='120' width='100' height='100' fill='%23daa520' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3Crect x='100' y='120' width='100' height='100' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 100,120 200,120' fill='%23a0522d' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 100,120 200,120' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Crect x='135' y='160' width='30' height='60' fill='%238b4513' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3Crect x='135' y='160' width='30' height='60' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='158' cy='192' r='2.5' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Crect x='110' y='145' width='15' height='15' fill='%2387ceeb' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3Crect x='110' y='145' width='15' height='15' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='117.5' y1='145' x2='117.5' y2='160' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='110' y1='152.5' x2='125' y2='152.5' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Crect x='175' y='145' width='15' height='15' fill='%2387ceeb' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3Crect x='175' y='145' width='15' height='15' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cline x1='182.5' y1='145' x2='182.5' y2='160' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='175' y1='152.5' x2='190' y2='152.5' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 5: Add Details %26 Color%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

title: Draw a Tree
description: Draw a beautiful tree with leaves and branches!

steps.instruction: Draw a rectangle for the tree trunk.
steps.tip: Make it straight and sturdy.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='130' y='160' width='40' height='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 1: Draw Trunk%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw a large circle or rounded shape on top for the leaves.
steps.tip: This represents the crown of the tree.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='130' y='160' width='40' height='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='100' r='70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 2: Add Foliage%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Add more branches by drawing 2-3 circles overlapping the first one.
steps.tip: This creates depth and makes the tree fuller.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='130' y='160' width='40' height='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='100' r='70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='110' cy='80' r='50' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='190' cy='80' r='50' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 3: Add Branches%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw small lines on the trunk to show texture and bark.
steps.tip: Add vertical lines for a realistic look.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='130' y='160' width='40' height='80' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='135' y1='160' x2='135' y2='240' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='145' y1='160' x2='145' y2='240' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='155' y1='160' x2='155' y2='240' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='165' y1='160' x2='165' y2='240' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='100' r='70' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='110' cy='80' r='50' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='190' cy='80' r='50' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 4: Add Texture%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Color it in! Use brown for the trunk and green for the leaves.
steps.tip: Add some shading for depth!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Crect x='130' y='160' width='40' height='80' fill='%238b6f47'/%3E%3Cline x1='135' y1='160' x2='135' y2='240' stroke='%23654321' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='145' y1='160' x2='145' y2='240' stroke='%23654321' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='155' y1='160' x2='155' y2='240' stroke='%23654321' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Cline x1='165' y1='160' x2='165' y2='240' stroke='%23654321' stroke-width='1'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='150' cy='100' r='70' fill='%2328a745' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='110' cy='80' r='50' fill='%2320c997' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='190' cy='80' r='50' fill='%2320c997' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 5: Add Colors%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

title: Draw a Butterfly
description: Create a colorful butterfly with beautiful wings!

steps.instruction: Draw an oval shape for the butterfly's body in the center.
steps.tip: Make it vertical and thin.
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+1:+Draw+Body

steps.instruction: Draw two large circles on the left side of the body for the left wings.
steps.tip: Make one larger (top) and one smaller (bottom).
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+2:+Add+Left+Wings

steps.instruction: Draw two circles on the right side to match the left wings.
steps.tip: Make them the same size as the left wings.
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+3:+Add+Right+Wings

steps.instruction: Add two long antennae (lines with small circles at the tips) on the head.
steps.tip: Make them curved and elegant!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+4:+Add+Antennae

steps.instruction: Add patterns and colors to the wings - stripes, dots, or shapes!
steps.tip: Be creative with colors!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+5:+Add+Patterns

title: Draw a Flower
description: Draw a beautiful flower with petals and a stem!

steps.instruction: Draw a circle in the center for the flower's center.
steps.tip: This is the heart of the flower!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+1:+Draw+Center

steps.instruction: Draw 5-6 rounded petals around the center circle.
steps.tip: Make them look like hearts or ovals pointing outward.
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+2:+Add+Petals

steps.instruction: Draw a long curved line from the bottom of the flower for the stem.
steps.tip: Make it wavy and natural-looking.
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+3:+Add+Stem

steps.instruction: Add two oval shapes on the stem for leaves.
steps.tip: Put one on each side of the stem.
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+4:+Add+Leaves

steps.instruction: Color the flower! Use pink or yellow for petals, and green for the stem and leaves.
steps.tip: Add small details like veins on the leaves!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+5:+Color+Flower

title: Draw a Sun
description: Draw a bright, happy sun with rays!

steps.instruction: Draw a circle in the center for the sun's body.
steps.tip: Make it nice and round!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+1:+Draw+Circle

steps.instruction: Draw 8-12 lines radiating out from the circle in all directions.
steps.tip: These are the sun's rays! Space them evenly.
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+2:+Add+Rays

steps.instruction: Add a happy face to the sun - two dots for eyes and a smile.
steps.tip: Make it friendly and cheerful!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+3:+Add+Face

steps.instruction: Optional: Add small triangles at the end of each ray.
steps.tip: This makes the rays look pointy and cool!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+4:+Triangle+Tips

steps.instruction: Color it yellow and add shading for depth.
steps.tip: Use orange for shadows to make it look 3D!
steps.image: https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Step+5:+Color+Sun

title: Draw a Fish
description: Create a cute little fish swimming in the water!

steps.instruction: Draw a horizontal oval shape for the fish's body.
steps.tip: Make it wider in the middle and pointy at one end.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='150' cy='150' rx='70' ry='40' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 1: Draw Body%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw a triangle at the right end for the tail fin.
steps.tip: Make it point backwards like it's swimming.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='140' cy='150' rx='70' ry='40' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='210,150 260,120 260,180' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 2: Add Tail%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Add two small triangles on top and bottom for the fins.
steps.tip: These help the fish balance and swim!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='140' cy='150' rx='70' ry='40' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='210,150 260,120 260,180' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,110 155,80 150,110' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,190 155,220 150,190' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 3: Add Fins%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Draw a small circle on the left side for the eye.
steps.tip: Add a tiny dot inside the eye to make it shine!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='140' cy='150' rx='70' ry='40' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='210,150 260,120 260,180' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,110 155,80 150,110' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,190 155,220 150,190' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='85' cy='145' r='10' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='87' cy='143' r='3' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 4: Add Eye%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Color the fish with bright colors - orange, pink, blue, or any color you like!
steps.tip: Add stripes or spots to make it unique!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='140' cy='150' rx='70' ry='40' fill='%23ff9500' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cellipse cx='140' cy='150' rx='70' ry='40' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='210,150 260,120 260,180' fill='%23ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='210,150 260,120 260,180' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,110 155,80 150,110' fill='%23ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,110 155,80 150,110' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,190 155,220 150,190' fill='%23ff6b9d' opacity='0.7'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='140,190 155,220 150,190' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='85' cy='145' r='10' fill='%23333'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='87' cy='143' r='3' fill='%23fff'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='160' cy='140' r='5' fill='%23fff' opacity='0.6'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='175' cy='155' r='5' fill='%23fff' opacity='0.6'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 5: Add Colors%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: Imagine a point at the top center. Draw a line going down to the bottom right.
steps.tip: Use light strokes, we'll connect them all.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cline x1='150' y1='60' x2='210' y2='210' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 1: First Line%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: From the bottom right, draw a line to the upper left.
steps.tip: Keep the angle consistent.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cline x1='150' y1='60' x2='210' y2='210' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='210' y1='210' x2='60' y2='110' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 2: Second Line%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: From the upper left, draw a line across to the right side.
steps.tip: This creates the middle of the star.
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cline x1='150' y1='60' x2='210' y2='210' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='210' y1='210' x2='60' y2='110' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='60' y1='110' x2='240' y2='110' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 3: Third Line%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: From the right side, draw a line down to the bottom left.
steps.tip: Almost there!
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cline x1='150' y1='60' x2='210' y2='210' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='210' y1='210' x2='60' y2='110' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='60' y1='110' x2='240' y2='110' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Cline x1='240' y1='110' x2='90' y2='210' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 4: Fourth Line%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E

steps.instruction: From the bottom left, draw the final line back to the top point to complete your star!
steps.tip: Color it in - maybe yellow or gold?
steps.image: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 300 300'%3E%3Crect fill='%23f8f9fa' width='300' height='300'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 210,210 60,110 240,110 90,210' fill='%23ffd700' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3Cpolygon points='150,60 210,210 60,110 240,110 90,210' fill='none' stroke='%23333' stroke-width='3'/%3E%3Ctext x='150' y='270' font-size='14' text-anchor='middle' fill='%23666'%3EStep 5: Complete Star%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
